appearance: System with browser color-scheme emulated light for Day and dark for Night
method: Playwright navigated each registered route, waited for DOMContentLoaded and 25 ms (650 ms for app entry routes), sampled visible button-like DOM nodes, and flagged non-gray/non-gold computed fills or blue/green top edges. This checks initial visible states only; semantic category colors, deeper states, overlays, gradients/text contrast, native touch and actual zoom require separate review.
